input_scope: leakage_review_v2.json for private dependence documentation only

remove_or_neutralize.rule: Replace any Existing SSH session transcript file with N attacker command(s) context with Observed command sequence for N=1 or Observed command sequence containing multiple commands for N>1.
Replace Real Linux administration-style transcript (...) with neutral observed command-sequence context.
Remove login, account, controlled-session, and historical provenance wording and replace with neutral observed command-sequence context.

prompt_normalization.regex_class: line-start shell prompt username@hostname followed by :~:, :/ or :#
prompt_normalization.scope: global across every evidence field; no case-specific exception

hostname_username_policy: Decorative prompt identities are normalized. Usernames, hostnames, paths, destinations, and account arguments inside behavioral evidence are preserved unless they match the decorative prompt rule.
behavior_preservation: Do not rewrite commands or arguments.
Do not rewrite outputs, paths, network targets, exploit syntax, payload behavior, or privilege operations.
Only context framing and decorative prompt tokens may change.
outcome_independence: No labels, predictions, disagreement, ground truth, or evaluation output are read or used for editing decisions.
